newsitem.title: HONG KONG: SEG sees 30 pct 97 net jump on warehouse.
newsitem.headline: SEG sees 30 pct 97 net jump on warehouse.

text.p: Expected income from a new warehouse is likely to push Shenzhen SEG Co Ltd's 1997 net profits up about 30 percent from 142.67 million yuan in 1996, a company official said on Friday.

The colour TV tube maker's 25,000-square-metre cargo warehouse, slated for opening in May, is expected to fuel an earnings surge, the official told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin.

The 70-million-yuan warehouse, located in Shenzhen's Futian bonded zone, is likely to benefit from Hong Kong's return to China which should result in closer economic ties with Shenzhen, he said. Hong Kong, bordering Shenzhen, reverts to Chinese rule on July 1, 1997.
Television tube prices, which dropped in tandem with China's colour TV prices in 1996, have stabilised this year, the official said.
"We expect slightly higher earnings from the sector in 1997," he said.
SEG on Friday posted a 61.71 percent surge in its 1996 net profits to 142.67 million yuan against 88.22 million yuan in 1995 based on Chinese accounting standards.
But sales fell 5.52 percent to 1.66 billion yuan from 1.75 billion yuan a year earlier.
Based on international standards, the company posted net profits of 127.22 million yuan for 1996 against 100.05 million yuan for 1995.
"Falls in TV tube prices were largely offset by lower raw materials costs and healthy profits from the transport and entertainment business areas," the official said.
